# Hack n Stay Golden Bay (Hack Farm)

> Eco farmstay, animal-friendly campground, and holistic beach horse rides near Paton's Rock, Golden Bay, New Zealand.

Hack n Stay Golden Bay (also known as Hack Farm) is a first-party farmstay and guided horse experience business run by Baerbel Hack at 22 Grant Road, Puramahoi, Takaka 7182, Golden Bay, South Island, New Zealand. Phone: +64 27 525 9434. Email: Stay@hackfarm.co.nz.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hackfarm.co.nz/): Overview of farmstay, camping, and beach horse rides near Paton's Rock.
- [About](https://hackfarm.co.nz/about/): Brand and founder story — Hack Farm, Hack n Stay, Baerbel Hack, and the Hack Vaulties club.
- [Accommodation](https://hackfarm.co.nz/accommodation/): Farmstay rooms, dog-friendly campground, and bring-your-own-horse stays.
- [Holistic Horse Rides](https://hackfarm.co.nz/holistic-horse-rides/): Guided beach and trail rides with a tide-aware sunrise planner for Paton's Rock.
- [Hack Farm Trails](https://hackfarm.co.nz/hack-farm-trails/): Interactive trail map and tide guidance for BYO horse riders.
- [Our Horses](https://hackfarm.co.nz/our-horses/): Meet the Hack Farm herd used for rides, lessons, and vaulting.
- [Learning Experiences](https://hackfarm.co.nz/learning-experiences/): Riding lessons, horsemanship, and vaulting for all ages.
- [Vaulting](https://hackfarm.co.nz/vaulting/): Hack Vaulties vaulting sessions with Baerbel Hack.
- [Special Events](https://hackfarm.co.nz/special-events/): Kids camps, horse club days, and special riding events.
- [Gift Vouchers](https://hackfarm.co.nz/horse-riding-holiday-gift-vouchers/): Gift cards for rides, stays, and learning experiences.
- [Contact](https://hackfarm.co.nz/contact/): Phone, email, and address for bookings and enquiries.
- [On-site weather station](https://hackfarm.infinityfree.me/FreshWDL/FreshWDL.html): Live FreshWDL weather readings from the property.
